contract: Designer prerequisites section 4.18 and native provider design section 6: outline selection is observable through native accessibility state updates.
change: Emit object:state-changed:selected for stable nodes when kSemanticsSelected changes; detail1 is 0 or 1. Existing enabled/sensitive/focusable notification behavior is preserved.
old_result: The native libatspi Designer client times out at its first selection_changed(Text, True) assertion after activating the Text row. GetState alone was covered before this change, but selected notifications were missing.
fixed_result: Text activation sends selected=1; ThemeScope activation sends Text selected=0 and ThemeScope selected=1. State reads agree and text edits produce no redundant selection notifications. Unicode text/events, theme references, document history and save/reopen still pass.
limitations: The native fixtures use the production provider with isolated D-Bus sessions; no Orca speech or operator-signed desktop record is implied.

The generic native loop initially failed before application registration while it ran concurrently with the Designer fixture; a separate retry passed. The registration failure log is retained and its exact cause is not established.
Windows Narrator/NVDA, macOS VoiceOver, real IME, Inspector, physical DPI/theme, drag/drop and complete platform records remain pending.
